metadata.title: Penmozhi — Period & Cycle Tracker
metadata.description: Science-based, privacy-first period and cycle tracking with predictions and daily logging — in Tamil and English.

landing.heroDescription: Science-based, privacy-first period and cycle tracking — fully available in Tamil and English. For everyone with a cycle.
landing.cardDescription: Track your cycle, log symptoms in seconds, and see when your period, PMS, and ovulation days are coming.

howItWorks.title: Track, predict, understand
howItWorks.step1Desc: Log your period, mood, pain, and symptoms with just a few taps each day.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Know when your period, PMS, and ovulation days are predicted to arrive.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Turn daily logs into insights — see how your cycle affects mood, energy, and symptoms.

features.title: Your complete cycle companion
features.description: From first period to perimenopause — track, predict, and understand your body at every stage.
features.cycleTrackingDesc: Log periods and get next-period predictions based on your personal history.
features.symptomTrendsDesc: Track how you feel each day and anticipate symptoms before they show up.
features.predictionsDesc: See predicted period, ovulation, fertile window, and PMS days on your calendar.
features.fertilityDesc: Know your fertile window and ovulation day when you're trying to conceive.
features.insightsDesc: Charts and trends reveal how your cycle length, pain, and mood change over time.
features.educationHubDesc: Browse trusted articles on menstrual health, PCOS, and wellness in your language.

privacy.eyebrow: Your data is safe with us
privacy.title: Privacy is non-negotiable
privacy.description: We never sell your health data. Your cycle logs, symptoms, and personal information stay private and under your control.

points.noSellingDesc: Your health information is never sold to advertisers or third parties.
points.youControlDesc: Export, update, or delete your account and data whenever you choose.
points.secureDesc: Encrypted connections and strict access controls protect your information.

testimonials.title: Real stories, real impact
testimonials.quote1: Tracking my symptoms gave me the confidence to talk to my doctor with actual data.
testimonials.quote2: I finally understand my cycle patterns. The predictions are surprisingly accurate.
testimonials.quote3: Having it in Tamil makes it so much easier for my family to use together.

cta.title: Start your cycle journey today
cta.description: Join Penmozhi and take control of your period, symptoms, and wellbeing — in Tamil or English.

footer.description: Science-based period and cycle tracking with predictions, symptom logging, and privacy-first design — in Tamil and English.
footer.privacyNote: We never sell your health data.

tips.default: Stay hydrated and listen to your body each day.
tips.menstrual: Rest when you need to. Warm fluids and gentle movement may ease cramps.
tips.follicular: Energy often rises after your period. A good time for new routines.
tips.fertile: You are in your fertile window. Track symptoms if you are planning or preventing pregnancy.
tips.ovulation: Ovulation day — peak fertility. Note any mittelschmerz or energy shifts.
tips.luteal: Progesterone rises. Prioritize sleep and balanced meals.
tips.pms: PMS window — mood and bloating are common. Be gentle with yourself.

gap.priorHelp: Add a missed period between these dates, or an earlier period before the last one, so predictions can use a typical cycle length.
